panels.title: Caption Lab | CPU application and host observability

options.content:
**DA3408 · BLIP base · CPU only**

Read top to bottom: availability → work rate → latency → hardware → client cohorts. All charts share a time axis and refresh every **5 seconds**. Rates use a 2-minute window. Run a bulk ZIP and compare its active-job band with host CPU and RAM below. Mode comparison charts: single = blue solid; bulk = orange dashed. Legends, points, units and linear axis labels retain meaning in print. Blank latency means no inference observations, not zero latency. Model readiness is separate from exporter availability.

panels.title: Metrics endpoint | scrape health
panels.description:
1 = reachable, 0 = failed scrape. This measures metrics availability, not model readiness.
AI prompt: Generate PromQL for a CPU BLIP Streamlit app: separate single and bulk, use rate over two minutes, histogram p50/p95, Summary sum/count means, node CPU idle fraction, MemAvailable RAM, and root disk available space; preserve missing observations as no data and label units explicitly. Use simple prefix regexes to color Single/single blue and Bulk/bulk orange.
